atoms.exact_source_text: Reach, Cut, Brace, and Render check Strain only after a Tool-supported Approach achieves its intended outcome.
atoms.normalized_claim: Reach, Cut, Brace, and Render check Strain only after a Tool-supported Approach achieves its intended outcome.

atoms.exact_source_text: One check is made per achieved Approach: 90% Holds, 10% Damaged.
atoms.normalized_claim: One Strain check is made per achieved Approach, with a 90% chance the Tool Holds and a 10% chance it becomes Damaged.

atoms.exact_source_text: Damage occurs after the full benefit and never retracts the outcome.
atoms.normalized_claim: Tool damage occurs after the full benefit is granted and never retracts the Approach's outcome.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Damaged Tool remains visible in its holder's Tool box, marked unavailable, for the rest of the Expedition.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Damaged Tool remains visible in its holder's Tool box, marked unavailable, for the rest of the Expedition.

atoms.exact_source_text: At Homecoming it automatically unequips, repairs during early DWELL, and returns to Home availability.
atoms.normalized_claim: At Homecoming, a Damaged Tool automatically unequips, repairs during early DWELL, and returns to Home availability.

atoms.exact_source_text: The former holder's Tool box remains empty until the player equips it again.
atoms.normalized_claim: The former holder's Tool box remains empty until the player equips the Tool again.

atoms.exact_source_text: Permanent Tool destruction occurs only as an explicit authored stake, not from ordinary Strain.
atoms.normalized_claim: Permanent Tool destruction occurs only as an explicit authored stake, not from ordinary Strain.

atoms.exact_source_text: Carry Tools operate as standing Cargo augmentation rather than active MEET interventions.
atoms.normalized_claim: Carry Tools operate as standing Cargo augmentation rather than active MEET interventions.

atoms.exact_source_text: They do not assign Focus or check Strain.
atoms.normalized_claim: Carry Tools do not assign Focus or check Strain.

atoms.exact_source_text: If an authored event removes one, Cargo capacity is immediately reconciled
atoms.normalized_claim: If an authored event removes a Carry Tool, Cargo capacity is immediately reconciled.

atoms.exact_source_text: only fungible Cargo is lost to overflow unless the event explicitly stakes a singular object.
atoms.normalized_claim: Only fungible Cargo is lost to overflow unless the event explicitly stakes a singular object.

atoms.exact_source_text: Render is Node-authored conversion, not an open crafting system.
atoms.normalized_claim: Render is Node-authored conversion, not an open crafting system.

atoms.exact_source_text: A successful Render Approach may create the indicated Supply, make matter safer to transport, separate usable material, or expose yield.
atoms.normalized_claim: A successful Render Approach may create the indicated Supply, make matter safer to transport, separate usable material, or expose yield.

atoms.exact_source_text: It cannot create arbitrary Supplies, Tools, Keepsakes, or Special Artifacts.
atoms.normalized_claim: Render cannot create arbitrary Supplies, Tools, Keepsakes, or Special Artifacts.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Render-created Supply may be placed into any present and capable Citizen's empty or already-spent Supply box.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Render-created Supply may be placed into any present and capable Citizen's empty or already-spent Supply box.

atoms.exact_source_text: It cannot displace an unspent Supply.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Render-created Supply cannot displace an unspent Supply.

atoms.exact_source_text: Placement is part of the Render outcome, not a transfer action, and the new carrier remains fixed for the rest of the Expedition.
atoms.normalized_claim: Placement of a Render-created Supply is part of the Render outcome, not a transfer action, and the new carrier remains fixed for the rest of the Expedition.

atoms.exact_source_text: Supplies are anonymous prepared units drawn from the Colony pool for one Expedition.
atoms.normalized_claim: Supplies are anonymous prepared units drawn from the Colony pool for one Expedition.

atoms.exact_source_text: They are broad physical capabilities rather than prepaid copies of Turn verbs or encounter-specific keys.
atoms.normalized_claim: Supplies are broad physical capabilities rather than prepaid copies of Turn verbs or encounter-specific keys.

atoms.exact_source_text: They have no maker, personal name, provenance record, or Item Tale.
atoms.normalized_claim: Supplies have no maker, personal name, provenance record, or Item Tale.

atoms.exact_source_text: The current functional classes are Binding, Remedy, Distraction, and Device.
atoms.normalized_claim: The current functional Supply classes are Binding, Remedy, Distraction, and Device.

atoms.exact_source_text: Their definitive names and recipes are controlled by the Supply specification
atoms.normalized_claim: The definitive names and recipes of Supply classes are controlled by the Supply specification.

atoms.exact_source_text: this document governs how all Supply classes behave in personal equipment and Encounter play.
atoms.normalized_claim: This document governs how all Supply classes behave in personal equipment and Encounter play.
